mnemonic: able(能够)+ity→「能力」，形容词 able 同源。
example: Her ability to solve complex problems impressed the committee.
exampleCn: 她解决复杂问题的能力给委员会留下了深刻印象。

mnemonic: a(在)+broad(宽广)→身在宽广的海外天地。
example: Many students choose to study abroad for a semester.
exampleCn: 许多学生选择出国留学一个学期。

mnemonic: ab(离开)+sent(送)→被送走而「缺席」；反 present。
example: Several students were absent from the professor's Monday morning lecture.
exampleCn: 有几名学生缺席了教授周一上午的课。

mnemonic: ac+cept(拿)→拿过来即「接受」；反 refuse。
example: The journal accepted her paper after two rounds of revision.
exampleCn: 经过两轮修改后，这家期刊接受了她的论文。

mnemonic: ac+cess(走)→能走近，即「进入/获取」；accessible 可及的。
example: Students can access the database through the university library website.
exampleCn: 学生可以通过大学图书馆网站访问该数据库。

mnemonic: ac+cid(落下)+ent→突然降临的「事故」。
example: The laboratory accident was caused by a careless mistake.
exampleCn: 这起实验室事故是由一个粗心的失误造成的。

mnemonic: ac+count(计数)→计数记账为「账户」，也指「描述/解释」。
example: The accountant checked the company's accounts at the end of the year.
exampleCn: 会计在年底核对了公司的账目。

mnemonic: ac+cur(关心)+ate→用心才「准确」；反 inaccurate。
example: The measurements were accurate to within one millimeter.
exampleCn: 这些测量结果精确到一个毫米以内。

mnemonic: act(行动)+ive→爱行动的「活跃的」；反 inactive。
example: Staying active helps older adults maintain their physical health.
exampleCn: 保持活跃有助于老年人维持身体健康。

mnemonic: act(做)+ivity→做事情即「活动」。
example: Extracurricular activities play an important role in student life.
exampleCn: 课外活动在学生生活中扮演重要角色。

mnemonic: 联想「add加」→往里添加，反 subtract(减)。
example: Add the two numbers together before dividing by three.
exampleCn: 先把这两个数相加，再除以三。

mnemonic: ad(加强)+ult(生长)→已经长成，即「成年人」；反 child。
example: Adult insects look quite different from their larvae.
exampleCn: 成年昆虫看起来与它们的幼虫大不相同。

mnemonic: ad(向)+vert(转)+ise→把信息转向大众，「宣传/做广告」。
example: The company advertised its new product on television and online.
exampleCn: 公司在电视和网络上为新产品做广告。

mnemonic: ad+vice(看)→给人自己的看法即「建议」；动词是 advise。
example: The professor gave useful advice on how to write a thesis.
exampleCn: 教授就如何写论文给出了有用的建议。

mnemonic: af+ford(前进)→钱够，才「付得起」。
example: Many families cannot afford private university tuition these days.
exampleCn: 如今许多家庭负担不起私立大学的学费。

mnemonic: 联想「afraid害怕」→心里发怵，近 scared。
example: She was afraid of failing the final examination.
exampleCn: 她害怕期末考试不及格。

mnemonic: a+gree(一致)→意见趋于一致；反 disagree。
example: The two researchers agree on the main cause of the decline.
exampleCn: 两位研究者就数量下降的主要原因达成一致。

mnemonic: 联想「aim瞄准」→对准靶心，即「目标」。
example: The program aims to improve literacy among young children.
exampleCn: 该项目旨在提高幼儿的读写能力。

mnemonic: al+arm(武器)→拿起武器拉响「警报」。
example: The fire alarm rang and everyone left the building quickly.
exampleCn: 火警响起，大家迅速离开了大楼。

mnemonic: al+most(大多)→差一点点就「几乎」全部。
example: Almost half of the students come from neighboring provinces.
exampleCn: 几乎一半的学生来自邻近省份。

mnemonic: a+lone(孤独)→「独自」一人，近 solitary。
example: The researcher spent months alone in the remote field station.
exampleCn: 这位研究员独自在偏远野外站点待了几个月。

mnemonic: a+long(长)→顺着长长的路「沿着」走。
example: We walked along the river to reach the ancient bridge.
exampleCn: 我们沿着河走，到达那座古桥。

mnemonic: al+ready(准备好)→事情「已经」准备好了。
example: The results had already been published when I arrived.
exampleCn: 我到的时候结果已经发表了。

mnemonic: al+though(虽然)→引导让步，「尽管」，近 though。
example: Although the task was difficult, the team finished it on time.
exampleCn: 尽管任务艰巨，团队还是按时完成了。

mnemonic: al+ways(路)→一直走下去，「总是」；反 never。
example: The library is always crowded during the final exam period.
exampleCn: 期末考试期间图书馆总是很拥挤。

mnemonic: a+maze(迷宫)+ing→让人惊呆，「惊人的」。
example: The diversity of coral reefs is truly amazing to observe.
exampleCn: 珊瑚礁的多样性观察起来确实令人惊叹。

mnemonic: a+mong(混杂)→混在众人「之中」。
example: The book was among the most cited works in the field.
exampleCn: 这本书是该领域被引用最多的著作之一。

mnemonic: 联想「anger愤怒」→被惹怒生气，形容词是 angry。
example: He could not hide his anger at the unfair decision.
exampleCn: 他无法掩饰对这个不公决定的愤怒。

mnemonic: an+nounce(说)→向大众说出，即「宣布」。
example: The dean announced the new scholarship program at the assembly.
exampleCn: 院长在大会上宣布了新的奖学金项目。

mnemonic: 谐音「answer答案」→给出「回答/答案」。
example: No one could answer the question about the rare species.
exampleCn: 没人能回答关于这个稀有物种的问题。

mnemonic: 联想「anxious焦虑」→急切担心，名词是 anxiety。
example: Students often feel anxious before an important oral presentation.
exampleCn: 学生在重要的口头展示前常感到焦虑。

mnemonic: a+part(部分)→分成几部分，「分开/相距」；反 together。
example: The two villages are five kilometers apart along the coast.
exampleCn: 这两个村庄沿海岸相距五公里。

mnemonic: apo+log(说)+ize→为过错辩解，转为「道歉」。
example: He apologized to the professor for submitting the paper late.
exampleCn: 他因迟交论文向教授道歉。

mnemonic: ap+pear(显现)→出现在眼前，也指「似乎」。
example: A rainbow appeared in the sky after the afternoon rain.
exampleCn: 下午雨后天空出现了一道彩虹。

mnemonic: ar+range(排列)→按序排列，即「安排/整理」。
example: The teacher arranged a tutoring session for the struggling student.
exampleCn: 老师为这名学习困难的学生安排了一次辅导。

mnemonic: ar+rive(岸)→靠岸即「到达」；反 depart。
example: The train arrived at the station just before the storm began.
exampleCn: 火车在暴风雨开始前刚好到达车站。

mnemonic: art(技艺)+icle→写就的「文章」，也指「物品/条款」。
example: She published an article about the effects of urban farming.
exampleCn: 她发表了一篇关于城市农业影响的文章。

mnemonic: a+side(边)→靠到一边，近 apart。
example: He stood aside to let the others pass through the door.
exampleCn: 他站到一边让别人进门。

mnemonic: 联想「ask问」→开口询问或请求，反 answer。
example: The student asked the librarian to recommend a reliable source.
exampleCn: 学生请图书管理员推荐一份可靠的资料。

mnemonic: a+sleep(睡)→处于「睡着」状态；反 awake。
example: The baby was fast asleep by the time the guests arrived.
exampleCn: 客人到达时宝宝已经熟睡了。

mnemonic: at+tach(钉)→钉上去，「附上/连接」；反 detach。
example: Please attach your transcript to the graduate application form.
exampleCn: 请把你的成绩单附在研究生申请表上。

mnemonic: at+tend(伸展)→身子伸向会场，「出席/参加」。
example: All first-year students must attend the orientation session.
exampleCn: 所有大一学生都必须参加迎新会。

mnemonic: apt(倾向)+itude→对事物的倾向即「态度」。
example: A positive attitude helps students overcome academic setbacks.
exampleCn: 积极的态度帮助学生克服学业挫折。

mnemonic: audi(听)+ence→听的人，「听众/观众」。
example: The audience applauded loudly after the orchestra's final piece.
exampleCn: 管弦乐队最后一曲结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。

mnemonic: a+wake(醒)→处于「醒着」状态；反 asleep。
example: The patient was still awake after the surgery.
exampleCn: 手术后病人仍然醒着。

mnemonic: a+ward(守卫)→因守护有功被「授予」奖项。
example: She won an award for the best documentary at the film festival.
exampleCn: 她在电影节上凭借最佳纪录片获奖。

mnemonic: 联想心脏 beat(跳动)→「敲打」，也指「击败/节拍」。
example: The bird beats its wings rapidly to stay in the air.
exampleCn: 这只鸟快速拍打翅膀以停留在空中。

mnemonic: beaut(美)+y→「美丽」，形容词是 beautiful。
example: The beauty of the sunset attracted many photographers to the hill.
exampleCn: 日落之美吸引了众多摄影师来到山丘。

mnemonic: be+come(来)→逐渐变成某种状态。
example: The small town has become a popular tourist destination.
exampleCn: 这个小镇已成为热门旅游目的地。

mnemonic: be+gin(开头)→「开始」，反 end。
example: The experiment will begin early next Monday morning.
exampleCn: 实验将于下周一清晨开始。
